title: Maintained real-cluster lab harness could not report a two-node srun failure because remote ssh had no wall-clock bound
note: This is a W57-owned evidence fragment, not the ACCEPTANCE_GREEN closeout manifest. artifacts/wave_W57/WAVE_W57_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json (FREEZE-044) is deliberately still unwritten because the owned acceptance gate is RED; see open_findings.

git_identity.head_subject: Build note: successor freeze after owner correction is W57-owned (RUNTIME-CUTOVER-002/003)

finding.observed_failure: Invoke-LabSshCapture (lab/lab-common.ps1:63-90 pre-fix) ran `& ssh @args` synchronously with no execution bound. ConnectTimeout=5 bounds only the TCP/handshake phase and ServerAliveInterval=5/ServerAliveCountMax=3 only fire when the transport dies. When compute02 is DOWN, Slurm holds the `srun --nodes=2 --ntasks=2` allocation PENDING on a perfectly healthy SSH channel, so `& ssh` never returned and lab-test.ps1 could neither PASS nor FAIL. It was hung indefinitely, not red.

reproduction_before_fix.command: lab-test.ps1:160 gate command `srun --nodes=2 --ntasks=2 --ntasks-per-node=1 hostname | sort -u` executed through the pre-fix Invoke-LabSshCapture
reproduction_before_fix.bounded_by: only an external 45s Wait-Job around the probe, proving the inner ssh itself had no bound

finding.hypothesis: The hang is caused by the absence of a hard local wall-clock bound and child kill on the ssh process, not by a missing SSH keepalive. Adding a bounded, killable execution path with a truthful timeout result makes the maintained harness terminate deterministically with a real FAIL.
change: lab/lab-common.ps1: added Get-LabCommandTimeoutSeconds / Get-LabAllocationTimeoutSeconds (config-driven with 180s/300s fallbacks).
lab/lab-common.ps1: added ConvertTo-LabProcessArguments (deterministic CommandLineToArgvW re-quoting of the argument vector).
lab/lab-common.ps1: added Invoke-LabBoundedCommand (hard WaitForExit(ms) bound, process-tree kill on expiry, exit 124 and a truthful stderr marker on timeout, never a false pass).

lab/lab-common.ps1: Invoke-LabSshCapture now routes through Invoke-LabBoundedCommand and additionally bounds the remote side with `timeout -k 5`, so a killed client cannot orphan a PENDING Slurm allocation. It also exposes timed_out / timeout_seconds / duration_seconds. No unbounded `& ssh` remains in the helper.
lab/lab-test.ps1: the three allocation-bound gates (srun, sbatch --wait, shared_home_job srun) request the longer allocation budget via the named -TimeoutSeconds parameter.

real_gate_command.command: srun --nodes=2 --ntasks=2 --ntasks-per-node=1 hostname | sort -u via post-fix Invoke-LabSshCapture -TimeoutSeconds 8
real_gate_command.interpretation: The maintained gate now terminates with a truthful failure instead of hanging forever, and is not a false pass.

result_after_fix.bounded_runner: a child that would run ~29s is terminated at a 3s bound (exit 124, timed_out=True, stderr carries the wall-clock marker)
result_after_fix.normal_path_unaffected: `hostname` on the controller still returns exit 0, output login-control01, timed_out=False
result_after_fix.argument_quoting: ['plain', 'a b c d', 'has"quote', ''] round-trips exactly through the re-quoting path

open_findings.reason: compute02 is DOWN, so the two-node lab gate cannot pass. lab-status.ps1 reports status: FAIL / slurm.ok: false. The local-real baseline in .opencode/protocol/LOCAL_REAL_HPC_LAB.md requires both compute nodes idle and a two-node srun PASS.
open_findings.blocking_authority: Operator recovery of the compute02 VM requires Hyper-V control. This session is not elevated: IsAdmin=False and Get-VM is denied (VirtualizationException), matching the already-accepted DEF-W57-006 classification. No elevation is obtainable from inside this phase and no result was synthesised.
open_findings.resume_point: Recover compute02 (lab/lab-reset.ps1 or an elevated lab/lab-up.ps1 / lab/lab-fault.ps1), then re-run lab/lab-status.ps1 to status: PASS and the maintained lab/lab-test.ps1. DEF-W57-017 no longer blocks this step: the harness is now bounded and will report the failure truthfully instead of hanging.
